# Conceptualist Systems — Pearson Edexcel IAL & IGCSE Past Papers & Textbooks Library

> Independent study archive; not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Pearson plc or Edexcel. Conceptualist Systems (https://www.conceptualist.uk) is a free, zero-ad academic study archive indexing 16,021 unique Pearson Edexcel International A-Level (IAL) and International GCSE (IGCSE 9-1 & Modular) Question Papers (QP), Mark Schemes (MS), Examiner Reports (ER), 73 Student Textbooks & Worked Solution Banks, 272 Listening Audio tracks with synced closed captions (CC), and 46 IT & Computer Science practical Data Files (19,882 total archived files covering January 2003 through June 2026).

## Core Platform Capabilities
- **Side-by-Side Split View Reader:** Open any paired Question Paper (QP) and Mark Scheme (MS) side by side in the browser with synchronized zoom and draggable split divider.
- **Resizable Two-Page Book Spread Mode:** Read all 73 Edexcel IAL & IGCSE student textbooks and standalone past papers in a 2-Page side-by-side spread with Pure OLED and Academic Dark reading modes.
- **In-Browser Worked Solution Bank Reader:** Stream all 14 Edexcel IAL Mathematics Worked Solution Banks (P1-P4, M1-M3, S1-S3, D1, FP1-FP3) chapter-by-chapter directly in the browser without downloading full ZIP archives.
- **Synced Listening Audio & Subtitles (CC):** Play MP3 and multi-track ZIP listening examinations above the Question Paper with clickable time-synced transcripts across French, German, Spanish, ESL, Chinese, and Swahili.

## Primary Archive Hubs
- [Library Homepage](https://www.conceptualist.uk/): Interactive subject, unit, and examination year navigator.
- [All Past Papers Catalog](https://www.conceptualist.uk/papers): Full searchable catalog of 16,021 unique Edexcel resources.
- [Edexcel IAL Past Papers](https://www.conceptualist.uk/ial): 19 International A-Level subjects (2003-2026).
- [Edexcel IGCSE Past Papers](https://www.conceptualist.uk/igcse): 43 International GCSE (9-1, Regional R, and Modular 4W*) subjects.
- [Textbooks & Worked Solution Banks](https://www.conceptualist.uk/textbooks): 73 student books, answer PDFs, lab books, and IAL Maths Solution Banks.
- [Edexcel IAL Textbooks & Solution Banks](https://www.conceptualist.uk/textbooks/ial): Student Book 1 & 2 PDFs, answers, and P1-P4/M1-M3/S1-S3/D1/FP1-FP3 Solution Banks.
- [Edexcel IGCSE (9-1) Textbooks](https://www.conceptualist.uk/textbooks/igcse): Verified student books across Mathematics A, Further Pure Maths, Sciences, Business, Commerce, Accounting, Economics, and ICT.
- [Listening Audio Archive (MP3 & Live CC)](https://www.conceptualist.uk/audio): 272 listening audio tracks and synced transcripts.
- [IT & Computer Science Practical Data Files](https://www.conceptualist.uk/data-files): 46 practical exam source ZIPs for WIT12, WIT14, 4IT1, and 4CP0.
